product.name: ScorX
product.tagline: Youth sports performance tracking and player development analytics

description: ScorX is an iOS app for recording, analysing, and developing youth athlete performance across 16 sports. It supports live game scoring, player-specific stat recording, athleticism benchmarking, AI-powered training recommendations, and shareable player graphics. Core tools are free for everyone. AI analytics, advanced analytics, and graphics are Premium.

personas.label: Coach
personas.core_message: Stop coaching on gut feel. Start developing with proof.
key_features: Match Invitations for distributed stat recording
Player rotations and playing time tracking

personas.label: Team Manager
personas.core_message: Everything your families need to know, in one place.

personas.label: Parent
personas.core_message: You've watched every game. Now you can prove every improvement.
key_features: Individual stat recording from the sideline

personas.label: Player / Athlete
personas.core_message: Your stats don't lie. Find out what's actually getting better.

pricing.summary: Two tiers: ScorX Free (always free, unlimited) and ScorX Premium (A$49.99/year or A$4.99/month, 30-day free trial, no credit card required).

graphics.summary: Built-in sports graphic generator. Shareable graphics are generated from games scored in the app — no manual data entry and no design template. Rendered on-device, so they work offline.

formats.label: Score update graphic
formats.description: Mid-game score graphic for quarter time, half time, or any point in the match.

formats.label: Final Score Card
formats.description: Full-time result with both team logos, round label, optional game photo background and optional score-type breakdown.

formats.label: Player stat card
formats.description: One player's game stats with a selectable stat set, slot ordering, optional player and game photo, and physical measurements.
formats.tier_note: One standard style is free. Full style library, sticker format and custom colour themes are Premium.

formats.label: Team stats table
formats.description: Full team stat line as a readable table. Available for team totals and for attacking, midfield and defensive categories.

formats.label: Team stats chart
formats.description: "How the game was built" — key stats plotted period by period with a colour-coded legend. Available for team totals and for attacking, midfield and defensive categories.

branding: Team logo (set once in Team Management)
ScorX or Team Colors palette on player cards
constraints: No watermark on the free plan
Uses each sport's own scoring format across all 16 sports

key_facts: Works fully offline — no internet required at the ground
Privacy-first — no ads, no third-party tracking, no data sharing
Family Sharing for up to 5 members (Premium)
AI Training Recommendations update every 30 days or after 5 games (Premium)
30-day free trial for Premium, no credit card required
